# pip itself, for workflows that start from a runner's bundled pip. That pip
# may vendor a certifi that still trusts the compromised eMudhra intermediate
# CA certificates, so HTTPS alone cannot vouch for what it downloads; the hash
# lets it install this exact file and nothing else. Install with
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r .github/pip-bootstrap-requirements.txt
pip==26.3 \
    --hash=sha256:6c36ae7da8695be67e3cd9f7d87919667ced53f57ce2ede75d89b5912ed2bc4c \
    --hash=sha256:f3b60b20ffaadd4415ed7957212a38ac63fa4c5fa375bd0f4a797777940fad13
